principles: Use deterministic code for validation, hashes, permissions, filters and ledger operations.
Choose the least costly available model and reasoning effort that meets the task acceptance criteria.
Escalate when ambiguity, conflicting sources, failed acceptance checks or high impact exceed the configured tier.
Model recommendations are candidates; the host harness remains the source of truth for available models and supported efforts.
Do not change the user's global model configuration. Record requested and actual model separately when the harness exposes both.

budget_behavior.context_selection: Pass relevant source snippets, current artifact, gate criteria, unresolved contradictions and required output only; include stable references and hashes.
budget_behavior.reuse: Reuse a prior result only when input hashes, prompt version and model identity still match.
budget_behavior.on_limit: Stop and record pending evidence, reduce scope with traceability, or escalate; never silently omit required evidence or retry without a limit.
budget_behavior.measurement: Record actual input, output, cached and reasoning tokens only when the harness reports them. Otherwise mark not_reported; character counts are not token counts.
budget_behavior.objective: Compare quality per completed task and total consumption including review and rework, not only tokens per call.

model_availability: Snapshot observed 2026-10-17. Selectors must check active harness availability and supported reasoning efforts at dispatch; availability changes.
